requirement.summary: Restructure Vendor & Payments as the accounting hub for all vendor-linked payables (Option A). Mirror Billing & Invoicing (PRD-4.1): shared filters, KPI dashboard, tabs (Awaiting Bills, Vendor Bills, Indirect Expenses, Payments, Debit Notes, Target Payment, Vendor Ledger), and a full Record Payment page. Direct track extends existing M5 PO→VendorInvoice→payment. Indirect track adds mark-first accrual (Dr expense category / Cr vendor AP) then pay via vendor voucher with FIFO allocation. Supersedes standalone expenses-and-payables for vendor-linked items.
acceptance: Sidebar: Vendor & payments is the hub; vendor-linked indirect expenses recorded and paid here (not standalone Expenses module)

KPIs: Total Purchases, Outstanding, Awaiting Bills, Total Indirect Expenses, Target Payment (cumulative due ≤ LEAST(today, filter.endDate)), Total Payment — all filter-scoped (month default, vendor, product)

Tabs: Awaiting Vendor Bills, Vendor Bills (vendor-grouped, multi-select), Indirect Expenses (Mark/Partially paid/Paid), Payments, Debit Notes (document-only, not PO), Target Payment (vendor-wise), Vendor Ledger
Record Payment page at /accounts/vendor-payments/record-payment with 5 sections; allocation toggle Vendor Bills vs Indirect Expenses; advance support; FIFO by due date
Direct flow unchanged at GL level: VendorInvoice + VendorPaymentVoucher invoice-first
Indirect: new accrual entity or extended Expense with vendorId; mark posts liability to vendor AP; payment allocates via VendorPaymentVoucher
Debit notes document-only (no AP posting), not tied to PO
Legacy /accounts/expenses retained only for non-vendor overhead if needed; redirect or slim per contract

api: GET /api/vendor-payments/outstanding-invoices — extend: groupBy, collectible, productId filter
POST /api/vendor-indirect-expenses — Phase 2: mark accrual (vendorId, categoryId, amount, dueDate)
ui: src/pages/Accounting/VendorPayments/VendorPaymentsMain.jsx — hub: shared filters, tabs, Record Payment nav
rules: Phase 1 (ship first): Direct-track UI parity with PRD-4.1/FD-2.1 — shared top filters (month default, vendor, product); KPIs filter-scoped; tabs Awaiting Vendor Bills, Vendor Bills (vendor-grouped multi-select), Payments, Debit Notes, Target Payment, Vendor Ledger; full Record Payment page for Vendor Bills FIFO only; reuse existing VendorInvoice + VendorPaymentVoucher GL (invoice-first)

Phase 2: Indirect track — extend Expense (vendorId, status, paidAmount) or VendorIndirectExpense; VendorPaymentVoucherItem.expenseId; Vendor.advance_credit; mark posts Dr expense category / Cr vendor AP; pay via voucher FIFO on open indirect; Indirect Expenses tab + Record Payment allocation toggle
Target Payment KPI/tab: unpaid VendorInvoice + marked indirect where dueDate <= LEAST(today, filter.endDate); no startDate lower bound (KB-004); Outstanding = all open AP
VendorInvoice: add dueDate if absent (invoiceDate + vendor terms); FIFO allocation by dueDate asc
Debit Notes: document-only (VendorDebitNote); not PO-linked; no AP posting
Advance: Vendor.advance_credit + voucher advanceAmount (mirror customer advance_credit)
Legacy /accounts/expenses: non-vendor overhead only; exclude vendor-linked from create/list

Hub tabs render; Awaiting Bills→register invoice; Vendor Bills multi-select→Record Payment deep-link

Phase 2: Mark indirect accrues AP; pay allocates via voucher; Marked→Partially paid→Paid
